ai.summary: Non-gazetted cadre employees of five new Government Medical Colleges in Jammu and Kashmir have struck for five consecutive days, demanding the Health and Medical Education Department notify recruitment rules for their cadre.

facts.claim: non-gazetted cadre employees of five new Government Medical Colleges in Jammu and Kashmir
facts.quote: non-gazetted cadre employees of five new Government Medical Colleges (GMCs) in Jammu and Kashmir

facts.claim: took out a rally from the Government Medical College's Associated Hospital campus
facts.quote: protesting employees took out a rally from the Government Medical College's Associated Hospital campus

facts.claim: raised slogans in support of their demands
facts.quote: raised slogans in support of their demands

facts.claim: called upon the Health and Medical Education Department to immediately notify the recruitment rules for the cadre
facts.quote: called upon the Health and Medical Education Department to immediately notify the recruitment rules for the cadre

facts.claim: accused the government of having failed to address their long-pending demand
facts.quote: accused the government of having failed to address their long-pending demand

facts.claim: alleging that despite repeated representations and protests, no concrete action was taken so far
facts.quote: alleging that despite repeated representations and protests, no concrete action was taken so far

facts.claim: urged the government to intervene without further delay
facts.quote: urged the government to intervene without further delay

facts.claim: stating that notification of recruitment rules was essential to resolve their service-related issues and address their grievances
facts.quote: stating that notification of recruitment rules was essential to resolve their service-related issues and address their grievances

ai.background_note: The strike involves non-gazetted cadre employees of five new Government Medical Colleges in Jammu and Kashmir, who have been demanding recruitment rules notification for their positions.
